negative.gain: raw RGB MSE0-MSEnative, perRGBFFT bands exclude DC; eps1e-8
negative.forecast_handling: only original frozen FULL RGB policies applied unchanged to shave sensitivity; shifted bands report actual effects only, no forecasts, re-fit or criterion re-test
negative.bootstrap: 10000 fixed-seed20261011 image clusters for fullRGB fixedpolicy deltaMSE vsnative; retrospective marginal sensitivity, not joint CI or prospective test
